title: SWF Gate
author: MeyerZon
description: Test-only mod for the SWF append gate (docs/swf-emitter-fix-spec.md §8): holds one generated donor SWF and a one-entry swflist.gon.append so the in-game harness can check that an _Append_AbilityIcon clip boots the game. Files are written by `npm run test:swfgate -- <variant>`; never ship this mod.
